header.name: [bedrock-research]entity-matchmaking-figures-bp_v1.0.0
header.description: v1.0.0 - A minigame lobby drawn in an entity inventory screen that shows every lobby member as a standing figure: real players and simulated players with emotes, bots that slowly look around, a ready check and cancel. Works next to the other entity inventory examples. Use the Minigame Lobby item from the creative inventory.
